purpose: Create and capacity-screen one dated restricted-share unlock pressure factor without reading any price or forward-return field.

source.provider: Eastmoney public restricted-share unlock data center

snapshot_contract.raw_ratio_interpretation: CURRENT_FREE_SHARES divided by total shares, expressed as a fraction rather than percentage points
snapshot_contract.zero_policy: zero is valid only for an observed stock/unlock date whose source TOTAL_RATIO is zero; stocks without an unlock event remain missing

factor.name: restricted_share_unlock_pressure
factor.event_availability: unlock date close, or the first local trading-session close on or after a non-trading unlock date; entry is the following local session open
factor.mechanism: A smaller realized restricted-share release relative to total shares may create less near-term supply overhang over the following three sessions.

sample_field_audit_before_freeze.repurchase_progress_candidate_rejected_w: Only 153 terminal repurchase amount-ratio dates met six-name/two-value coverage over 2019-2025, with 0 dates in 2020 and 2023 and nearly all capacity in 2024-2025.
sample_field_audit_before_freeze.investor_qa_candidate_rejected_without_r: The official Shanghai interaction search UI limits supported retrieval to the latest 30 days and no common Shanghai/Shenzhen 2019-2025 point-in-time archive was available.
sample_field_audit_before_freeze.major_contract_revenue_share_candidate_r: The source prior-year revenue and normalized revenue-share fields were nearly absent in 2024-Q1 and 2025-Q1, while later revisions made current latest-revenue fields unsuitable for historical point-in-time normalization.
